extra_quotes: The artifact mediates one master per configuration, and its IOPU table covers only the active slot: the shim, not the gate, keeps the external master off the journal.
The reset counter survives core resets, but not power cycles, so a deployable one requires non-volatile backing, and the reset escape is simulated only.
